summary: XSS injection vulnerability in the search endpoint.

validation.note: benign tag reflected unescaped in HTML

remediation.config_change: HTML-escape term before writing it into the page for GET /search (html/template or the framework's auto-escaping renderer); send Content-Type: text/html; charset=utf-8 and a Content-Security-Policy without 'unsafe-inline'.
remediation.virtual_patch:
SecRule ARGS:term "@detectXSS" "id:9100002,phase:2,deny,status:403,log,t:urlDecodeUni,t:htmlEntityDecode,msg:'assay xss-reflected virtual patch f-a0cb21c9adcc085f',tag:'assay/xss-reflected'"
{"class":"xss-reflected","engine":"modsecurity","finding":"f-a0cb21c9adcc085f","id":9100002,"rule":"SecRule ARGS:term \"@detectXSS\" \"id:9100002,phase:2,deny,status:403,log,t:urlDecodeUni,t:htmlEntityDecode,msg:'assay xss-reflected virtual patch f-a0cb21c9adcc085f',tag:'assay/xss-reflected'\""}

summary: Healthcheck endpoint contains a SQL injection vulnerability.

remediation.config_change: Replace string concatenation with a parameterized query (placeholders and bound arguments) for GET /healthcheck parameter <parameter>; reject input that fails a strict allowlist before it reaches the database; run the application's database role with SELECT-only grants where the endpoint only reads.
remediation.virtual_patch:
SecRule ARGS:* "@detectSQLi" "id:9100001,phase:2,deny,status:403,log,t:urlDecodeUni,t:lowercase,msg:'assay sqli virtual patch f-cdfe850c885d5dda',tag:'assay/sqli'"
